query_start_time.description: Start of the time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g. `2026-02-01T00:00:00Z`). Required unless `cursor` is provided. Must be within the last 90 days and no earlier than `2026-02-18T00:00:00Z`.
query_start_time.title: Start Time

query_end_time.description: End of the time range in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to the current time. Must be after `start_time`.
query_end_time.title: End Time

query_cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned in a previous response as `next_cursor`. When provided, `start_time` and `end_time` are ignored.
query_cursor.title: Cursor

query_limit.description: Maximum number of events to return per page. Minimum `1`, maximum `100`. Values outside this range are clamped automatically.
query_limit.title: Limit

query_app_ids.description: Filter events by app UUID. Accepts up to 10 values. Org-level events are always included. Repeat the parameter for multiple values: `app_ids=uuid1&app_ids=uuid2`.
query_app_ids.title: App Ids

query_actions.description: Filter by action type (e.g. `notification.sent`, `segment.created`). Accepts up to 20 values. Repeat the parameter for multiple values: `actions=notification.sent&actions=segment.created`.
query_actions.title: Actions

query_actor_ids.description: Filter by actor UUID (the user or service that performed the action). Accepts up to 10 values. Repeat the parameter for multiple values: `actor_ids=uuid1&actor_ids=uuid2`.
query_actor_ids.title: Actor Ids

query_actor_emails.description: Filter by actor email address. Accepts up to 10 values. Repeat the parameter for multiple values: `actor_emails=a@example.com&actor_emails=b@example.com`.
query_actor_emails.title: Actor Emails

query_target_types.description: Filter by the type of resource the action was performed on (e.g. `notification`, `segment`, `journey`). Accepts up to 10 values. Repeat the parameter for multiple values: `target_types=notification&target_types=segment`.
query_target_types.title: Target Types

query_target_ids.description: Filter by the UUID of the resource the action was performed on. Accepts up to 10 values. Repeat the parameter for multiple values: `target_ids=uuid1&target_ids=uuid2`.
query_target_ids.title: Target Ids

query_ip_addresses.description: Filter by the IP address the action originated from. Accepts up to 10 values. Repeat the parameter for multiple values: `ip_addresses=203.0.113.1&ip_addresses=203.0.113.2`.
query_ip_addresses.title: Ip Addresses
